The '''Ord Radama system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
